{"bugs_found": ["__add__ computes year with `(self.year and other.year) + self.years` instead of using absolute year fallback semantics; relativedelta without `year` raises TypeError when applied to a date/datetime.", "__add__ ignores an absolute `year` value when it is provided, using `other.year` instead, so year replacement contract is violated.", "relativedelta(dt1, dt2) construction is broken because it calls __radd__ with `self.year is None`, triggering the same TypeError instead of producing a delta where dt2 + delta == dt1."], "verdict": "REQUEST_CHANGES"}
